newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices gain on fresh export demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices gain on fresh export demand.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery rose to 1,178/1,179 rupees per quintal from 1,170/1,171 rupees with fresh export enquiries triggering buying while rising prices prompted short-covering, traders said.
"Arrivals of castorseed fell in producing centres due to the yearend but is seen picking up," one trader said.

Groundnut oil fell from 343/344 rupees to 340/341 rupees per 10 kg on sluggish physical buying and fresh arrivals. Rajkot spot oil slid by five to 515/520 rupees. "Sentiment remained subdued on expectation of arrivals of about 7-7,500 tonnes of imported palm oil at Bombay port next week," one miller said.
